editorial.blurb: Apsara serves phenomenal Cambodian and Thai cuisine with bold, authentic flavors and a warm, homey atmosphere that feels like family.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask your server about spice levels—they range from 2 to 15, so you can customize your heat; first-timers should try level 5 to experience how the spice enhances rather than overpowers the flavor.

topDishes.note: Legendary lemongrass marinade with unique flavor you won't find elsewhere
Coconut custard catfish steamed in banana leaf with rich, complex flavors
Described as the crispiest wings ever
